name: GitHub REST API
description: Provider-level connection to the GitHub REST API. Holds one credential and endpoint; operation families are separate tool items.

provenance.notes: Supports API version 2026-03-10 and the issues operation families referenced by associated_tool_refs. required_scopes uses this project's notation '<fine-grained permission>:<access>' for the GitHub fine-grained token permission named on the endpoint page; auth_methods api_key represents a fine-grained personal access token (bearer token). OAuth app and GitHub App installation tokens were not verified today and are omitted.
rate_limit_per_minute omitted: limits are per hour (5,000/h) plus 900 points/min secondary, not a single per-minute number.
